newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sony says sees record group operating profit.
newsitem.headline: Sony says sees record group operating profit.

text.p: Sony Corp said on Thursday that it expects its group operating profit to hit a record high of 305 billion yen for this business year to March 31, 1997.
The previous high was 302.2 billion yen in the 1990-91 fiscal year, the company said.
Sony attributed this year's expected increase to the decline in the yen against the dollar, which boosted its yen-denominated income and overseas sales.
The company also revised up its full-year capital investment plan to 300 billion yen from 280 billion yen.
Sony said the upward revision was also due to the yen's decline.
Sony said it posted foreign exchange profits of 7.6 billion yen in the second quarter of the current fiscal year.
